        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目详情（包含所有关联数据）\n   */\n  async getProjectDetails(projectId: number): Promise&lt;ProjectDetails | null&gt; {\n    const project = await this.findById(projectId);\n    if (!project) return null;\n\n    // 使用 Promise.all 并行获取所有关联数据，每个查询都有独立的错误处理\n    const [techPoints, knowledgePoints, files, sourceInformations, packagingMaterials, promotionStrategies, pressReleases] = await Promise.all([\n      this.getTechPoints(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getTechPoints error:', err);\n        return [];\n      }),\n      this.getKnowledgePoints(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getKnowledgePoints error:', err);\n        return [];\n      }),\n      this.getFiles(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getFiles error:', err);\n        return [];\n      }),\n      this.getSourceInformations(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getSourceInformations error:', err);\n        return [];\n      }),\n      this.getPackagingMaterials(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getPackagingMaterials error:', err);\n        return [];\n      }),\n      this.getPromotionStrategies(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getPromotionStrategies error:', err);\n        return [];\n      }),\n      this.getPressReleases(projectId).catch(err =&gt; {\n        console.error('getPressReleases error:', err);\n        return [];\n      })\n    ]);\n\n    const result = {\n      ...project,\n      techPoints,\n      knowledgePoints,\n      files,\n      sourceInformations,\n      packagingMaterials,\n      promotionStrategies,\n      pressReleases\n    };\n\n    // 序列化日期对象为字符串，确保 JSON 响应正常\n    return this.serializeDates(result);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 序列化对象中的日期为字符串\n   * 防止循环引用导致的问题\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目列表\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const {\n        page = 1,\n        pageSize = 20,\n        orderBy = 'created_at',\n        orderDirection = 'DESC',\n        status,\n        type\n      } = req.query;\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      } else {\n        // 默认只显示活跃状态\n        options.where.status = ProjectStatus.ACTIVE;\n      }\n\n      if (type) {\n        options.where.type = type;\n      }\n\n      const result = await projectModel.findAll(options);\n      \n      // 为每个项目添加来源数量和技术点数量\n      const projectsWithCounts = await Promise.all(\n        result.data.map(async (project) =&gt; {\n          const [sourceCount, techPointCount] = await Promise.all([\n            projectModel.getSourceCount(project.id),\n            projectModel.getTechPointCount(project.id)\n          ]);\n          return {\n            ...project,\n            sourceCount,\n            techPointCount\n          };\n        })\n      );\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: {\n          ...result,\n          data: projectsWithCounts\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get projects error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取项目列表失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async getFeatured(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新项目\n   */\n  async update(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的项目ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const data: UpdateProjectDTO = req.body;\n      const project = await projectModel.update(id, data);\n      \n      if (!project) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '项目不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: project,\n        message: '项目更新成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Update project error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新项目失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新最后打开时间\n   */\n  async updateLastOpenedAt(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/project/:projectId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const projectId = parseInt(req.params.projectId);\n    \n    if (isNaN(projectId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的项目ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取项目来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取项目来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class DatabaseManager {\n\n\n  // 事务支持（简化版本）\n  async transaction(): Promise&lt;{\n    query: (sql: string, params?: any[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;any&gt;;\n    commit: () =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n    rollback: () =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;;\n  }&gt; {\n    // 简化的事务实现，实际项目中需要更完善的事务管理\n    return {\n      query: async (sql: string, params: any[] = []) =&gt; {\n        return await this.query(sql, params);\n      },\n      commit: async () =&gt; {\n        // 在实际实现中，这里应该提交事务\n        return Promise.resolve();\n      },\n      rollback: async () =&gt; {\n        // 在实际实现中，这里应该回滚事务\n        return Promise.resolve();\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例数据库管理器\nexport const db = new DatabaseManager();",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 查找重复的AI角色\n   * 重复判断标准：相同的name或相同的name+source组合\n   */\n  async findDuplicates(): Promise&lt;{\n    duplicates: Array&lt;{\n      key: string; // 重复的标识（name或name+source）\n      roles: AIRoleConfig[];\n      keep: AIRoleConfig; // 保留的角色（保留updated_at最新的）\n      remove: AIRoleConfig[]; // 需要删除的角色\n    }&gt;;\n    totalDuplicates: number;\n  }&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const allRoles = await this.getAll();\n    const duplicateMap = new Map&lt;string, AIRoleConfig[]&gt;();\n\n    // 按name分组\n    for (const role of allRoles) {\n      const key = &#96;${role.name}|${role.source || 'null'}&#96;;\n      if (!duplicateMap.has(key)) {\n        duplicateMap.set(key, []);\n      }\n      duplicateMap.get(key)!.push(role);\n    }\n\n    // 找出重复项（同一key有多个角色）\n    const duplicates: Array&lt;{\n      key: string;\n      roles: AIRoleConfig[];\n      keep: AIRoleConfig;\n      remove: AIRoleConfig[];\n    }&gt; = [];\n\n    for (const [key, roles] of duplicateMap.entries()) {\n      if (roles.length &gt; 1) {\n        // 按updated_at排序，保留最新的\n        const sorted = [...roles].sort((a, b) =&gt; \n          b.updatedAt.getTime() - a.updatedAt.getTime()\n        );\n        const keep = sorted[0];\n        const remove = sorted.slice(1);\n\n        duplicates.push({\n          key,\n          roles,\n          keep,\n          remove,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      duplicates,\n      totalDuplicates: duplicates.reduce((sum, d) =&gt; sum + d.remove.length, 0),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除多个AI角色\n   */\n  async deleteMultiple(ids: string[]): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 清除重复的AI角色\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-roles/duplicates\n * Body: { confirm: true } - 需要确认\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义\n */\nrouter.delete('/duplicates', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { confirm } = req.body;\n\n    if (!confirm) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '请提供confirm=true来确认删除操作'\n      ));\n    }\n\n    // 查找重复项\n    const { duplicates } = await aiRoleModel.findDuplicates();\n\n    if (duplicates.length === 0) {\n      return res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\n        deleted: 0,\n        message: '没有找到重复的角色'\n      }, '没有重复角色需要清除'));\n    }\n\n    // 收集所有需要删除的角色ID\n    const idsToDelete: string[] = [];\n    for (const duplicate of duplicates) {\n      idsToDelete.push(...duplicate.remove.map(r =&gt; r.id));\n    }\n\n    // 删除重复角色\n    const deletedCount = await aiRoleModel.deleteMultiple(idsToDelete);\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\n      deleted: deletedCount,\n      duplicates: duplicates.length,\n      details: duplicates.map(d =&gt; ({\n        key: d.key,\n        kept: d.keep.id,\n        removed: d.remove.map(r =&gt; r.id),\n      })),\n    }, &#96;成功清除 ${deletedCount} 个重复角色&#96;));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('清除重复角色失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '清除重复角色失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 创建AI角色\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles\n */\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "export class ConsensusDetector {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 混合检测（语义分析 + 投票）\n   */\n  private async detectByHybrid(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    config: ConsensusDetectionConfig\n  ): Promise&lt;ConsensusResult&gt; {\n    // 并行执行两种方法\n    const [semanticResult, votingResult] = await Promise.all([\n      this.detectBySemanticAnalysis(session, messages, participants, config).catch(() =&gt; null),\n      this.detectByVoting(session, messages, participants, config).catch(() =&gt; null),\n    ]);\n\n    // 合并结果\n    if (!semanticResult &amp;&amp; !votingResult) {\n      return this.detectBySimpleAnalysis(messages, participants, config);\n    }\n\n    if (!semanticResult) return votingResult!;\n    if (!votingResult) return semanticResult;\n\n    // 加权合并\n    const hasConsensus = semanticResult.hasConsensus &amp;&amp;         "contents": "export class DebateModeManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 评判辩论\n   */\n  private async judgeDebate(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    roundNumber: number,\n    messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    proParticipants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    conParticipants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    judgeRoleId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;DebateJudgment | null&gt; {\n    const messagesText = this.formatMessagesForJudgment(messages, proParticipants, conParticipants);\n\n    const prompt = &#96;你是一位专业的辩论裁判。请对以下辩论进行评判。\n\n讨论话题：${session.topic}\n${session.description ? &#96;话题描述：${session.description}\\n&#96; : ''}\n\n正方参与者：\n${proParticipants.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i + 1}. ${p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家'}&#96;).join('\\n')}\n\n反方参与者：\n${conParticipants.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i + 1}. ${p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家'}&#96;).join('\\n')}\n\n辩论记录：\n${messagesText}\n\n请从以下维度进行评判：\n1. **论证质量**：逻辑是否清晰，论证是否有力\n2. **论据支撑**：是否有充分的案例、数据或理论支撑\n3. **反驳效果**：是否有效回应对方观点\n4. **语言表达**：是否清晰、准确、有说服力\n5. **整体表现**：综合表现如何\n\n请以JSON格式返回评判结果：\n{\n  \"roundNumber\": ${roundNumber},\n  \"proScore\": 7.5,\n  \"conScore\": 8.0,\n  \"winner\": \"con\",\n  \"proStrengths\": [\"优势1\", \"优势2\"],\n  \"conStrengths\": [\"优势1\", \"优势2\"],\n  \"proWeaknesses\": [\"不足1\", \"不足2\"],\n  \"conWeaknesses\": [\"不足1\", \"不足2\"],\n  \"overallAnalysis\": \"总体分析...\",\n  \"nextRoundFocus\": \"下一轮应该重点关注...\"\n}\n\n评分标准：\n- 每方得分：0-10分\n- winner: \"pro\" | \"con\" | \"tie\"\n- 如果得分差距小于0.5，则为\"tie\"&#96;;\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 修复文件名编码（处理 UTF-8 被误读为 Latin-1 的情况）\n   */\n  private fixFileNameEncoding(originalName: string): string {\n    try {\n      // 检测是否包含乱码字符（UTF-8 被误读为 Latin-1 的典型特征）\n      // 包括：ã, å, ä, è, ç, æ, Ã, â 等常见乱码字符\n      const hasGarbledChars = /ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/.test(originalName);\n      \n      if (hasGarbledChars) {\n        // 策略1: 尝试将整个字符串按 Latin-1 编码转换为 UTF-8\n        try {\n          const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\n          const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\n          \n          // 验证解码后的字符串是否更合理\n          // 1. 包含中文字符（最可靠的指标）\n          const hasChinese = /[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded);\n          // 2. 或者解码后的字符串包含更多可打印字符（排除控制字符）\n          const originalPrintable = (originalName.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n          const decodedPrintable = (decoded.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n          const isMoreReadable = decodedPrintable &gt; originalPrintable;\n          // 3. 检查是否包含更少的乱码字符\n          const originalGarbled = (originalName.match(/ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/g) || []).length;\n          const decodedGarbled = (decoded.match(/ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/g) || []).length;\n          const hasLessGarbled = decodedGarbled &lt; originalGarbled;\n          \n          if (hasChinese || (isMoreReadable &amp;&amp; hasLessGarbled)) {\n            logger.info('文件名编码已修复', { \n              before: originalName, \n              after: decoded,\n              hasChinese,\n              isMoreReadable,\n              hasLessGarbled\n            });\n            return decoded;\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          logger.debug('策略1修复失败', { error: e });\n        }\n        \n        // 策略2: 如果策略1失败，尝试修复混合编码的情况\n        // 检测并修复部分乱码的字符串\n        try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class DebateModeManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 格式化消息用于评判\n   */\n  private formatMessagesForJudgment(\n    messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    proParticipants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    conParticipants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[]\n  ): string {\n    const lines: string[] = [];\n    const proIds = new Set(proParticipants.map(p =&gt; p.id));\n    const messagesByRound = new Map&lt;number, BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt;();\n\n    for (const msg of messages) {\n      if (!messagesByRound.has(msg.roundNumber)) {\n        messagesByRound.set(msg.roundNumber, []);\n      }\n      messagesByRound.get(msg.roundNumber)!.push(msg);\n    }\n\n    const sortedRounds = Array.from(messagesByRound.keys()).sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);\n\n    for (const round of sortedRounds) {\n      lines.push(&#96;\\n[轮次 ${round}]&#96;);\n      const roundMessages = messagesByRound.get(round)!;\n\n      // 按正反方分组\n      const proMessages = roundMessages.filter(m =&gt; m.participantId &amp;&amp; proIds.has(m.participantId));\n      const conMessages = roundMessages.filter(m =&gt; m.participantId &amp;&amp; !proIds.has(m.participantId));\n\n      if (proMessages.length &gt; 0) {\n        lines.push('【正方】');\n        proMessages.forEach(msg =&gt; {\n          const participant = proParticipants.find(p =&gt; p.id === msg.participantId);\n          const name = participant?.displayName || participant?.aiRole?.name || '未知';\n          lines.push(&#96;${name}: ${msg.content}&#96;);\n        });\n      }\n\n      if (conMessages.length &gt; 0) {\n        lines.push('【反方】');\n        conMessages.forEach(msg =&gt; {\n          const participant = conParticipants.find(p =&gt; p.id === msg.participantId);\n          const name = participant?.displayName || participant?.aiRole?.name || '未知';\n          lines.push(&#96;${name}: ${msg.content}&#96;);\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return lines.join('\\n');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 解析评判响应\n   */\n  private parseJudgmentResponse(content: string, roundNumber: number): DebateJudgment | null {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    \n    // 读取 SQL 文件并执行\n    const fs = require('fs');\n    const path = require('path');\n    const sqlPath = path.join(__dirname, '../../scripts/create-brainstorm-tables.sql');\n    \n    try {\n      const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf-8');\n      // 按分号分割 SQL 语句\n      const statements = sql\n        .split(';')\n        .map((s: string) =&gt; s.trim())\n        .filter((s: string) =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n      \n      for (const statement of statements) {\n        try {\n          await this.db.query(statement);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略\"表已存在\"等错误\n          if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n            console.warn('执行 SQL 语句时出现警告:', error.message);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 如果文件不存在，使用内联 SQL\n      if (error.code === 'ENOENT') {\n        await this.initializeTableInline();\n      } else {\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 内联初始化表（当 SQL 文件不存在时使用）\n   */\n  private async initializeTableInline(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const createTablesSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_sessions (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        topic TEXT NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        creator_id TEXT,\n        project_id INTEGER,\n        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'stopped')),\n        config TEXT,\n        summary TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        completed_at DATETIME\n      );\n\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_participants (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        ai_role_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        display_name TEXT,\n        role_type TEXT,\n        sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n      );\n\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_messages (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n        participant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n        round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        content TEXT NOT NULL,\n        reply_to_id TEXT,\n        metadata TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n        FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n        FOREIGN KEY (reply_to_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function setupProjectTables() {\nconst statements = \n(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0);\n    \n    for (const statement of statements) {\n      try {\n        await db.query(statement);\n        const preview = statement.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').substring(0, 60);\n        console.log('✓ 执行成功:', preview + '...');\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n        if (error.message &amp;&amp; (\n          error.message.includes('already exists') || \n          error.message.includes('duplicate') ||\n          error.message.includes('UNIQUE constraint')\n        )) {\n          const preview = statement.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').substring(0, 60);\n          console.log('⚠ 已存在，跳过:', preview + '...');\n        } else if (error.message &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('no such table')) {\n          // 如果表不存在，可能是执行顺序问题，记录但不中断\n          const preview = statement.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').substring(0, 60);\n          console.warn('⚠ 表不存在，稍后重试:', preview + '...');\n          console.warn('   错误:', error.message);\n        } else {\n          const preview = statement.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').substring(0, 60);\n          console.error('✗ 执行失败:', preview + '...');\n          console.error('   错误:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 如果第一次执行有表不存在的错误，再执行一次索引创建\n    console.log('\\n检查并创建缺失的索引...');\n    const indexStatements = statements.filter(s =&gt; s.toUpperCase().includes('CREATE INDEX'));\n    for (const statement of indexStatements) {\n      try {\n        await db.query(statement);\n}",

        "contents": "export class ContentConcatenationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 验证选择的项目数据格式\n   */\n  private validateSelectedItems(selectedItems: SelectionItem[]): { isValid: boolean; errors: string[] } {\n    const errors: string[] = [];\n    \n    if (!Array.isArray(selectedItems)) {\n      errors.push('selectedItems必须是数组');\n      return { isValid: false, errors };\n    }\n    \n    if (selectedItems.length === 0) {\n      errors.push('selectedItems不能为空');\n      return { isValid: false, errors };\n    }\n\n    if (selectedItems.length &gt; 50) {\n      errors.push('selectedItems数量不能超过50个，以确保性能');\n    }\n    \n    // 验证每个选择项的格式\n    selectedItems.forEach((item, index) =&gt; {\n      if (!item.knowledgePointId) {\n        errors.push(&#96;第${index + 1}项缺少knowledgePointId&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      if (!item.contentType) {\n        errors.push(&#96;第${index + 1}项缺少contentType&#96;);\n      } else if (!['knowledge_point', 'tech_packaging', 'tech_promotion', 'tech_press'].includes(item.contentType)) {\n        errors.push(&#96;第${index + 1}项的contentType无效: ${item.contentType}&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      if (!item.knowledgePoint) {\n        errors.push(&#96;第${index + 1}项缺少knowledgePoint对象&#96;);\n      } else {\n        const kp = item.knowledgePoint;\n        if (!kp.id || !kp.techPoint) {\n          errors.push(&#96;第${index + 1}项的knowledgePoint对象缺少必要字段&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // 检查是否有重复的知识点ID和内容类型组合\n    const combinations = new Set();\n    selectedItems.forEach((item, index) =&gt; {\n      const combination = &#96;${item.knowledgePointId}-${item.contentType}&#96;;\n      if (combinations.has(combination)) {\n        errors.push(&#96;第${index + 1}项存在重复的知识点ID和内容类型组合: ${combination}&#96;);\n      }\n      combinations.add(combination);\n    });\n    \n    return { isValid: errors.length === 0, errors };\n  }\n  \n  /**\n   * 获取内容统计信息\n   */\n  private getContentStats(selectedItems: SelectionItem[]): {\n    totalItems: number;\n    uniqueKnowledgePoints: number;\n    contentTypeDistribution: Record&lt;ContentType, number&gt;;\n  } {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 执行SQL语句（支持多语句）\n */\nasync function executeSQL(sql: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const statements = sql\n    .split(';')\n    .map(s =&gt; s.trim())\n    .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n\n  for (const statement of statements) {\n    if (statement.trim()) {\n      try {\n        await db.query(statement);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略表已存在的错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('duplicate') &amp;&amp;\n            !error?.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn(&#96;⚠️  执行SQL语句失败:&#96;, error?.message);\n          console.warn(&#96;SQL: ${statement.substring(0, 100)}...&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 从统一架构文件中提取特定表的创建语句\n */\nasync function createTablesFromUnifiedSchema(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('📋 从统一架构文件创建缺失的表...');\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 查找重复的AI角色\n * GET /api/v1/ai-roles/duplicates\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义，否则会被当作 id 处理\n */\nrouter.get('/duplicates', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const duplicates = await aiRoleModel.findDuplicates();\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, duplicates, '查找重复角色成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('查找重复角色失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '查找重复角色失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 清除重复的AI角色\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-roles/duplicates\n * Body: { confirm: true } - 需要确认\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义\n */",

        "contents": "/**\n * 修复数据库中已存在的乱码文件名\n * 运行方式: npx ts-node backend/src/scripts/fix-garbled-filenames.ts\n */\n\nimport { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * 修复文件名编码\n */\nfunction fixFileNameEncoding(originalName: string): string {\n  try {\n    const hasGarbledChars = /ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/.test(originalName);\n    \n    if (hasGarbledChars) {\n      // 策略1: 尝试将整个字符串按 Latin-1 编码转换为 UTF-8\n      try {\n        const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\n        const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\n        \n        const hasChinese = /[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded);\n        const originalPrintable = (originalName.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n        const decodedPrintable = (decoded.match(/[\\x20-\\x7E\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g) || []).length;\n        const isMoreReadable = decodedPrintable &gt; originalPrintable;\n        const originalGarbled = (originalName.match(/ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/g) || []).length;\n        const decodedGarbled = (decoded.match(/ã|å|ä|è|ç|æ|Ã|â|€|¥/g) || []).length;\n        const hasLessGarbled = decodedGarbled &lt; originalGarbled;\n        \n        if (hasChinese || (isMoreReadable &amp;&amp; hasLessGarbled)) {\n          return decoded;\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        // 忽略错误\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (e) {\n    // 忽略错误\n  }\n  return originalName;\n}\n\nasync function fixGarbledFilenames() {\n  const db = new DatabaseManager();\n}",

        "contents": "import DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { db } from '@/config/database';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteAiSearchDTO } from '../dto/executeAiSearch.dto';\n\nexport class ExecuteAiSearchUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteAiSearchDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      logger.info('执行 AI 搜索', { query: dto.query });\n\n      const processedInputs = await this.processInputs(dto.inputs);\n      const result = await DifyClient.aiSearch(dto.query, processedInputs, dto.conversationId ?? '');\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('AI 搜索执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'AI_SEARCH_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'AI搜索失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async processInputs(inputs: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {}) {\n    const processedInputs = { ...inputs } as Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;\n\n    const selectedKnowledgePoints = inputs.selectedKnowledgePoints;\n    if (Array.isArray(selectedKnowledgePoints) &amp;&amp; selectedKnowledgePoints.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        const contentService = createContentConcatenationService(db);\n        const concatenatedContent = await contentService.buildContextFromSelectedItems(selectedKnowledgePoints);\n\n        processedInputs.knowledgeContext = concatenatedContent.contextString;\n        processedInputs.knowledgeContextSummary = concatenatedContent.summary;\n        processedInputs.originalSelectedKnowledgePoints = selectedKnowledgePoints;\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.error('知识点内容拼接失败', { error });\n        processedInputs.knowledgeContextError = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '内容拼接失败';\n      }\n    }\n\n    return processedInputs;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ConsensusDetector {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 语义分析检测（使用Agent分析）\n   */\n  private async detectBySemanticAnalysis(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    config: ConsensusDetectionConfig\n  ): Promise&lt;ConsensusResult&gt; {\n    const roleId = config.analyzerRoleId || participants[0]?.aiRoleId;\n    if (!roleId) {\n      throw new Error('没有可用的Agent进行共识分析');\n    }\n\n    const messagesText = this.formatMessagesForAnalysis(messages, participants);\n    \n    const prompt = &#96;你是一位专业的讨论分析专家。请分析以下讨论是否已达成共识。\n\n讨论话题：${session.topic}\n${session.description ? &#96;话题描述：${session.description}\\n&#96; : ''}\n\n参与专家：\n${participants.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i + 1}. ${p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家'}&#96;).join('\\n')}\n\n最近讨论记录：\n${messagesText}\n\n请从以下维度分析：\n1. **观点一致性**：专家们的核心观点是否一致\n2. **分歧程度**：是否存在明显分歧，分歧是否已解决\n3. **共识强度**：达成的共识是表面一致还是深度一致\n4. **讨论成熟度**：讨论是否已经充分，是否还有未解决的问题\n\n请以JSON格式返回分析结果：\n{\n  \"hasConsensus\": true,\n  \"confidence\": 0.85,\n  \"consensusTopics\": [\"共识主题1\", \"共识主题2\"],\n  \"remainingDisagreements\": [\"分歧点1\", \"分歧点2\"],\n  \"participantAgreement\": {\n    \"participantId1\": 0.9,\n    \"participantId2\": 0.8,\n    \"participantId3\": 0.7\n  },\n  \"analysis\": \"详细分析说明...\"\n}\n\n评分标准：\n- hasConsensus: 如果70%以上专家在核心问题上达成一致，则为true\n- confidence: 0-1，基于共识的强度和一致性\n- consensusTopics: 列出明确达成共识的具体主题\n- remainingDisagreements: 列出仍然存在的分歧点（如果有）\n- participantAgreement: 每个参与者的同意度（0-1）&#96;;\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function backupDatabase(dbPath: string, backupDir: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * 初始化新数据库\n */\nasync function initializeDatabase(targetDbPath: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('📋 初始化新数据库...');\n\n  const db = new DatabaseManager();\n  \n  try {\n    await db.connect();\n\n    // 读取并执行架构脚本\n    const schemaPath = path.join(__dirname, 'unified-database-schema-v3.sql');\n    if (fs.existsSync(schemaPath)) {\n      const schemaSql = fs.readFileSync(schemaPath, 'utf-8');\n      // 分割SQL语句并执行\n      const statements = schemaSql\n        .split(';')\n        .map(s =&gt; s.trim())\n        .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n\n      for (const statement of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(statement);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表已存在的错误\n          if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n            console.warn(&#96;执行SQL警告: ${error.message}&#96;);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      console.log('✅ 数据库架构初始化完成');\n    } else {\n      console.warn(&#96;⚠️  架构文件不存在: ${schemaPath}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 读取并执行索引脚本\n    const indexesPath = path.join(__dirname, 'unified-database-indexes-v3.sql');\n    if (fs.existsSync(indexesPath)) {\n      const indexesSql = fs.readFileSync(indexesPath, 'utf-8');\n      const statements = indexesSql\n        .split(';')\n        .map(s =&gt; s.trim())\n        .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith('--'));\n\n      for (const statement of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(statement);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          if (!error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n            console.warn(&#96;创建索引警告: ${error.message}&#96;);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      console.log('✅ 数据库索引创建完成');\n    }\n\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 主函数：执行完整迁移流程\n */\nasync function runMigration(options: MigrationOptions = {}): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('🚀 开始数据库迁移流程');\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\nprivate async initializeTableInline(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst createIndexesSQL = &#96;\n&#96;;\n\n    try {\n      // 执行创建表语句\n      const tableStatements = createTablesSQL.split(';').filter(s =&gt; s.trim().length &gt; 0);\n      for (const statement of tableStatements) {\n        try {\n          await this.db.query(statement);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          if (!error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n            console.warn('创建表时出现警告:', error.message);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 执行创建索引语句\n      const indexStatements = createIndexesSQL.split(';').filter(s =&gt; s.trim().length &gt; 0);\n      for (const statement of indexStatements) {\n        try {\n          await this.db.query(statement);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          if (!error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n            console.warn('创建索引时出现警告:', error.message);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 迁移：添加 project_id 字段（如果不存在）\n      await this.migrateAddProjectId();\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.warn('初始化头脑风暴表时出现警告:', error.message);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 迁移：添加 project_id 字段\n   */\n  private async migrateAddProjectId(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class DebateModeManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行一方（正方或反方）的发言\n   */\n  private async executeSideTurn(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    side: 'pro' | 'con',\n    roundNumber: number,\n    historyMessages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    instruction: string\n  ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {\n    const messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[] = [];\n\n    // 并行执行该方的所有参与者\n    const promises = participants.map(async (participant) =&gt; {\n      const query = this.buildDebateQuery(\n        session,\n        participant,\n        side,\n        roundNumber,\n        historyMessages,\n        instruction\n      );\n\n      const conversationId = &#96;${session.id}_${participant.id}_${side}&#96;;\n\n      try {\n        const result = await this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(\n          participant.aiRoleId,\n          query,\n          conversationId,\n          {\n            topic: session.topic,\n            description: session.description,\n            roundNumber,\n            side,\n            participantName: participant.displayName || participant.aiRole?.name || '专家',\n          }\n        );\n\n        return await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n          sessionId: session.id,\n          participantId: participant.id,\n          roundNumber,\n          content: result.content,\n          metadata: {\n            promptTokens: result.usage.promptTokens,\n            completionTokens: result.usage.completionTokens,\n            totalTokens: result.usage.totalTokens,\n            model: result.metadata?.model,\n            finishReason: result.metadata?.finishReason,\n            debateSide: side,\n          },\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;辩论参与者 ${participant.id} 执行失败:&#96;, error);\n        return await brainstormMessageModel.create\n\n    };\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "export class DebateModeManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行辩论轮次\n   */\n  async executeDebateRound(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    roundNumber: number,\n    config: DebateConfig\n  ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {\n    const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(session.id);\n    const historyMessages = await brainstormMessageModel.getBySessionId(session.id);\n\n    // 分离正反方参与者\n    const proParticipants = participants.filter(p =&gt; config.proRoleIds.includes(p.aiRoleId));\n    const conParticipants = participants.filter(p =&gt; config.conRoleIds.includes(p.aiRoleId));\n\n    if (proParticipants.length === 0 || conParticipants.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('辩论模式需要至少一个正方和一个反方参与者');\n    }\n\n    const messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[] = [];\n\n    // 第一轮：正方先发言\n    if (roundNumber === 1) {\n      // 正方发言\n      const proMessages = await this.executeSideTurn(\n        session,\n        proParticipants,\n        'pro',\n        roundNumber,\n        historyMessages,\n        '请从正方角度阐述你的观点，支持讨论话题。'\n      );\n      messages.push(...proMessages);\n\n      // 反方发言\n      const conMessages = await this.executeSideTurn(\n        session,\n        conParticipants,\n        'con',\n        roundNumber,\n        [...historyMessages, ...proMessages],\n        '请从反方角度反驳正方观点，提出不同意见。'\n      );\n      messages.push(...conMessages);\n    } else {\n      // 后续轮次：交替发言\n      // 先让反方回应上一轮的正方观点\n      const conMessages = await this.executeSideTurn\n;\n  }\n}",

tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        const hasProjectId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n        \n        if (!hasProjectId) {\n          console.log('检测到 source_information 表缺少 project_id 字段，正在添加...');\n          await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER&#96;);\n          await db.query(&#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id)&#96;);\n          console.log('成功添加 project_id 字段');\n        }\n      } catch (migrationError: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在或其他错误，记录但不中断\n        if (!migrationError?.message?.includes('duplicate column')) {\n          console.warn('迁移 project_id 字段时出现警告:', migrationError?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ProjectController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取项目列表\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const {\n        page = 1,\n        pageSize = 20,\n        orderBy = 'created_at',\n        orderDirection = 'DESC',\n        status,\n        type\n      } = req.query;\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        offset: (parseInt(page as string) - 1) * parseInt(pageSize as string),\n        orderBy: orderBy as string,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      } else {\n        // 默认只显示活跃状态\n        options.where.status = ProjectStatus.ACTIVE;\n      }\n\n      if (type) {\n        options.where.type = type;\n      }\n\n      const result = await projectModel.findAll(options);\n      \n      // 为每个项目添加来源数量和技术点数量\n      const projectsWithCounts = await Promise.all(\n        result.data.map(async (project) =&gt; {\n          const [sourceCount, techPointCount] = await Promise.all([\n            projectModel.getSourceCount(project.id),\n            projectModel.getTechPointCount(project.id)\n          ]);\n          return {\n            ...project,\n            sourceCount,\n            techPointCount\n          };\n        })\n      );\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: {\n          ...result,\n          data: projectsWithCounts\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Get projects error:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取项目列表失败',\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async getFeatured(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件（支持单个或多个文件）\n   */\n  async uploadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const uploadMiddleware = upload.array('files', 50); // 最多支持50个文件\n      \n      uploadMiddleware(req, res, async (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('文件上传失败:', err);\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: err.message || '文件上传失败'\n          });\n        }\n\n        const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n        if (!files || files.length === 0) {\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: '未选择文件'\n          });\n        }\n\n        try {\n          const { category_id, description, uploaded_by } = req.body;\n          const categoryId = category_id !== undefined \n            ? (category_id === 'null' || category_id === null ? null : parseInt(category_id))\n            : undefined;\n          const uploadedBy = uploaded_by ? parseInt(uploaded_by) : undefined;\n\n          // 批量上传文件\n          const uploadResults = await Promise.all(\n            files.map(file =&gt; \n              publicKnowledgeService.saveUploadedFile(\n                file,\n                categoryId,\n                description, // 所有文件共享同一个描述\n                uploadedBy\n              )\n            )\n          );\n\n          res.status(201).json({\n            success: true,\n            data: uploadResults.length === 1 ? uploadResults[0] : uploadResults,\n            message: uploadResults.length === 1 \n              ? '文件上传成功' \n              : &#96;成功上传 ${uploadResults.length} 个文件&#96;\n          });\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error('保存文件失败:', error);\n          res.status(500).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '保存文件失败'\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('上传文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有车系\n   */\n  async getAll(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n      const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 10;\n      const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n      const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string)?.toUpperCase() === 'DESC' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC';\n      const status = req.query.status as CarSeriesStatus;\n      const modelId = req.query.modelId ? parseInt(req.query.modelId as string) : undefined;\n      const brandId = req.query.brandId ? parseInt(req.query.brandId as string) : undefined;\n      const includeModel = req.query.includeModel === 'true';\n      const includeBrand = req.query.includeBrand === 'true';\n\n      const options = {\n        limit: pageSize,\n        offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n        orderBy,\n        orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n        where: {} as any,\n        includeModel,\n        includeBrand\n      };\n\n      if (status) {\n        options.where.status = status;\n      }\n      if (modelId) {\n        options.where.model_id = modelId;\n      }\n\n      let result;\n      if (brandId) {\n        result = await this.carSeriesModel.findByBrandId(brandId, options);\n      } else {\n        result = await this.carSeriesModel.findAll(options);\n      }\n      \n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: result.carSeries,\n        pagination: {\n          page,\n          pageSize,\n          total: result.total,\n          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / pageSize)\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取车系列表失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取车系列表失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据车型获取车系\n   */\n  async getByModel(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync update(id: number, data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n\n\n    try {\n      console.log(&#96;更新来源信息 id=${id}, SQL: ${sql}, Values:&#96;, values);\n      await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      const updated = await this.findById(id);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;更新后无法找到来源信息 id=${id}&#96;);\n      }\n      return updated;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(&#96;更新来源信息失败 id=${id}:&#96;, error);\n      console.error(&#96;SQL: ${sql}&#96;);\n      console.error(&#96;Values:&#96;, values);\n      console.error(&#96;Error details:&#96;, {\n        message: error?.message,\n        code: error?.code,\n        errno: error?.errno,\n        stack: error?.stack\n      });\n      \n      // 如果是字段不存在的错误，尝试添加字段后重试\n      if (error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id')) {\n        console.log('检测到 project_id 字段不存在，尝试添加后重试...');\n        try {\n          await this.ensureProjectIdColumn();\n          // 重试更新\n          await this.db.query(sql, values);\n          const updated = await this.findById(id);\n          if (!updated) {\n            throw new Error(&#96;更新后无法找到来源信息 id=${id}&#96;);\n          }\n          console.log(&#96;重试更新成功 id=${id}&#96;);\n          return updated;\n        } catch (retryError: any) {\n          console.error(&#96;重试更新失败:&#96;, retryError);\n          throw retryError;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据source_id更新来源信息\n   */\n  async updateBySourceId(sourceId: string, data: UpdateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        WHERE cm.id = ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车型不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const carModel = carModels[0] as any;\n      \n      if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n        return {\n          ...carModel,\n          brand: {\n            id: carModel.brand_id,\n            name: carModel.brand_name,\n            name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n          }\n        } as CarModel;\n      }\n      \n      return carModel as CarModel;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车型失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechnologyModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找技术IP\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;Technology&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM technologies WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const technologies = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (technologies.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('技术IP不存在');\n      }\n      \n      return technologies[0] as Technology;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('查找技术IP失败:', error);\n      if (error.message === '技术IP不存在') {\n        throw error;\n      }\n      throw new Error('查找技术IP失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有技术IP\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllTechnologiesOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ technologies: Technology[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const {\n      limit = 50,\n      offset = 0,\n      orderBy = 'created_at',\n      orderDirection = 'DESC',\n      includeBrand = true\n    } = options;\n\n    // 构建WHERE条件\n    let whereClause = '';\n    let whereParams: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (options.where) {\n      const conditions: string[] = [];\n      \n      if (options.where.name) {\n        conditions.push('cm.name LIKE ?');\n        whereParams.push(&#96;%${options.where.name}%&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.brand_id) {\n        conditions.push('cm.brand_id = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.brand_id);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.status) {\n        conditions.push('cm.status = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.status);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.category) {\n        conditions.push('cm.category = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.category);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.launch_year) {\n        conditions.push('cm.launch_year = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.launch_year);\n      }\n      \n      if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n        whereClause = 'WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 查询总数\n    const countSql = &#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM car_models cm ${whereClause}&#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, whereParams);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n\n    // 查询数据\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.* FROM car_models cm\n      ${whereClause}\n      ORDER BY cm.${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    if (includeBrand)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrandModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有品牌\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllBrandsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ brands: Brand[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const {\n      limit = 50,\n      offset = 0,\n      orderBy = 'created_at',\n      orderDirection = 'DESC'\n    } = options;\n\n    // 构建WHERE条件\n    let whereClause = '';\n    let whereParams: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (options.where) {\n      const conditions: string[] = [];\n      \n      if (options.where.name) {\n        conditions.push('name LIKE ?');\n        whereParams.push(&#96;%${options.where.name}%&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.status) {\n        conditions.push('status = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.status);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.country) {\n        conditions.push('country = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.country);\n      }\n      \n      if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n        whereClause = 'WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 查询总数\n    const countSql = &#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM brands ${whereClause}&#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, whereParams);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n\n    // 查询数据\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM brands \n      ${whereClause}\n      ORDER BY ${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [...whereParams, limit, offset];\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const brands = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [];\n      \n      return {\n        brands: brands as Brand[],\n        total\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查询品牌列表失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查询品牌列表失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新品牌\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateBrandDTO): Promise&lt;Brand&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrandModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建品牌\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateBrandDTO): Promise&lt;Brand&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO brands (name, name_en, logo_url, country, founded_year, description, status)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const params = [\n      data.name,\n      data.name_en || null,\n      data.logo_url || null,\n      data.country || null,\n      data.founded_year || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.status || BrandStatus.ACTIVE\n    ];\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      \n      return await this.findById(insertId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('创建品牌失败:', error);\n      if (error.message?.includes('UNIQUE constraint failed')) {\n        throw new Error('品牌名称已存在');\n      }\n      throw new Error('创建品牌失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找品牌\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;Brand&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

          }
        },
        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\nasync create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n\n\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      // SQLite 不支持 RETURNING，需要先插入再查询\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO tech_points (\n          name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n          priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n          keywords, source_url, created_by, tpd_id, car_models_info, \n          resources_info, knowledge_info\n        )\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      if (!insertId) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to create tech point: no ID returned');\n      }\n      const created = await this.findById(insertId);\n      if (!created) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to retrieve created tech point');\n      }\n      return created;\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL 支持 RETURNING\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO tech_points (\n          name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n          priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n          keywords, source_url, created_by, tpd_id, car_models_info, \n          resources_info, knowledge_info\n        )\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n        RETURNING *\n      &#96;;\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class ProjectModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有项目\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;Project&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM projects';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        if (value === null) {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} IS NULL&#96;);\n        } else {\n          conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = countResult[0].count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const data = result.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseRow(row)) as Project[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取精选项目\n   */\n  async findFeatured(limit: number = 10): Promise&lt;Project[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM projects \n      WHERE type = ? AND status = ?\n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n      LIMIT ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync findById(id: number, includeModel: boolean = true, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarSeries&gt; {\n&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carSeries = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carSeries.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车系不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const series = carSeries[0] as any;\n      \n      // 解析metadata\n      if (series.metadata &amp;&amp; typeof series.metadata === 'string') {\n        try {\n          series.metadata = JSON.parse(series.metadata);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('解析metadata失败:', error);\n          series.metadata = null;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      if (includeModel &amp;&amp; series.model_name) {\n        const model: any = {\n          id: series.model_id,\n          name: series.model_name,\n          name_en: series.model_name_en\n        };\n        \n        if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; series.brand_name) {\n          model.brand = {\n            id: series.brand_id,\n            name: series.brand_name,\n            name_en: series.brand_name_en\n          };\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          ...series,\n          model\n        } as CarSeries;\n      }\n      \n      return series as CarSeries;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车系失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车系失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车系\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarSeriesOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carSeries: CarSeries[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",
